requirements.statement: For each indication of colour given by a text (a text that refers to a colour to convey something), the information is not given by colour alone.

citations.quote: Pour chaque indication de couleur donnée par un texte, l’information ne doit pas être donnée uniquement par la couleur.
Retrouver dans le document les informations données par la couleur dans un texte
Information transmise visuellement par l’intermédiaire d’une couleur.

routes.statement: The same information is also given by a visible text.

The same information is also given by a graphic means (pictogram, background image, shape, different border style) together with a complement in the code (aria-label, title, hidden text, aria-current).

citations.quote: Un moyen faisant intervenir du graphisme (pictogramme, image de fond, forme, style de bordure différent, etc.) et par le biais d’un complément au niveau du code (aria-label, title, texte masqué, aria-current, etc.)

routes.statement: The same information is also given by another typographic style (bold, italic, text size, another font) together with a complement in the code.

citations.quote: Un autre style typographique (gras, italique, taille de texte, autre police, etc) et par le biais d’un complément au niveau du code

routes.statement: Another means lets the user get the same information, from the methodology's open list: a title attribute, an icon, a graphic effect of shape or position, a typographic effect.

citations.quote: vérifier qu’il existe un autre moyen de récupérer cette information (présence d’un attribut title, d’une icône ou d’un effet graphique de forme ou de position, un effet typographique…)
Les moyens de transmettre une information autrement que par la couleur peuvent être

rationale.text: The test applies to each indication of colour given by a text, such as a sentence saying that fields in red are required. Finding those texts is judgment: it means reading what a text says and whether it points to a colour that conveys something. A list of colour words would match texts that only describe a product or a picture, and miss indications phrased otherwise, so no check can find the applicable texts completely or surely. Each route is judgment too: whether a text, a pictogram, a shape, a style or a code complement gives the same information as the colour depends on what both mean. The requirement has one set of routes, taken from the glossary and the methodology: a visible text, a graphic means with a code complement, a typographic style with a code complement, or another means from the methodology's open list (a title attribute, an icon, a shape or position effect, a typographic effect). The glossary's list says the means "peuvent être" these, and the methodology's list ends in an ellipsis, so the last route is kept open on purpose: a missed route would make a correct page look failed. The glossary also says that information given by colour and accompanied by another method makes the criterion not applicable, where the methodology says the test is then validated. The entry follows the methodology and lists the means as routes; at none the difference changes nothing, and it is reported. No axe rule is tagged for this test, and no custom check is registered: a fault would need a witness that is surely an indication of colour carrying information, which needs reading. The candidate is none, with no link. Applicability is judgment: whether a page holds such an indication cannot be decided by code. Needs is empty: the texts are read on the page as displayed.

Lorsqu’une information donnée par la couleur est accompagnée d’une autre méthode à destination des utilisateurs qui ne voient pas ou perçoivent mal les couleurs ou leurs associations, le critère sera considéré comme non applicable.
Si c’est le cas pour chaque information, **le test est validé**.
